newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Khmer Rouge must hand Pol Pot over soon - Ranaridd.
newsitem.headline: Khmer Rouge must hand Pol Pot over soon - Ranaridd.

text.p: Cambodia's first prime minister said on Tuesday a Khmer Rouge splinter faction holding rebel leader Pol Pot must hand him over within days if it wants to strike an amnesty deal with the government.

Prince Norodom Ranariddh also dismissed doubts that Pol Pot was being detained by the guerrillas. He said arrangements would be made for at least one journalist to be taken to see Pol Pot to put an end to the scepticism.
"We have to talk about days, otherwise I cannot trust them," the prince said of the breakaway faction which turned against Pol Pot earlier this month.
He said the government could not let the matter drag on.
"If they are asking for an amnesty they have to be logical...and hand over Pol Pot to us," he said.
Pol Pot fled his Anlong Veng headquarters in the northwest of Cambodia earlier this month after the execution of his defence chief and almost a dozen of his family members.
The renegade Khmer Rouge faction captured Pol Pot last Thursday.
More than one million Cambodians died of starvation, disease and hard labour, or were executed as enemies of the Khmer Rouge during Pol Pot's "killing fields" rule in the 1970s.
